messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "non-fatal MI in adults with clinically evident CHD"
set: ["non-fatal MI in adults with clinically evident CHD", "non-fatal stroke", "LDL-C in adults with primary hyperlipidemia", "weight loss in adults with obesity", "non-fatal heart attack", "adults with obesity", "non-fatal cardiovascular events", "edema in adults with chronic heart failure", "fibromyalgia in adults", "edema in adults with chronic kidney disease", "depression in adults", "OCD in adults", "adults with atrial fibrillation", "treatment of adults with", "moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity", "not common in adults"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
